entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Avinash Kulshrestha, learned counsel for the appl  Shri Anil Shukla, learned Public Prosecutor for the re State.

Learned counsel for the applicant seeks for and is granted permission to withdraw this fourth bail application under Section 439 of CrPC filed by the applicant in connection with Crime No.558/2020 registered at Police Station Station Road, District Morena for offence under Sections 272, 273 and 420 of IPC and Sections 26, 51 and 57 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 with liberty to revisit this Court after recording of evidence of some important prosecution witnesses.
With aforesaid liberty, the application is dismissed as withdrawn.
ALOK Digitally signed by ALOK KUMAR KUMAR Date: 2021.06.07 (Rajeev Kumar Shrivastava)
